title: Rise of QAnon: A Mental Model of Good and Evil Stews in an Echochamber
reasoning: The paper investigates the 'Good versus Evil' moral schema and religious identification (e.g., identifying as 'Christian' or mentioning 'God') as central cognitive factors in the adoption of conspiratorial beliefs. It uses NLP techniques (topic modeling) to analyze these moral and religious themes within the QAnon network.
